title: Free Walking Tours and Berlin Then and Now: Quick Summary
items: **Free walking tours usually use tips as payment.** Check each operator's booking and payment conditions.
**Berlin Then and Now has a fixed price paid when booking.** I stopped running tip-based walks in September 2026.
**My route:** World Clock at Alexanderplatz to Hackescher Markt, about 2.5 hours and about 3 km.
**Eleven stops and sixteen places,** with an archive photograph at every stop.
**Museums are viewed from outside.** My route explores the historic centre of the former East Berlin and does not follow the Wall line.
**Check current dates before booking.** Use the booking page for the departure and current price.
